entries.title: Extermination

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for higher internal resolution and modern display options.

primary.why: The North American PS2 release is the best practical English-language pick for a US audience; Extermination has no sourced higher-fidelity port, remaster, or remake.
primary.how_to_play: Play the North American PS2 disc on compatible hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for modern display options.

all_releases.fidelity: European PS2 release, with significant European/North American version differences including protagonist redesign and rerecorded dialogue.
all_releases.reason: skip: noteworthy regional variant, but the North American release is the primary English route for this archive.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The European and North American versions differ in protagonist design and rerecorded dialogue; the North American version is chosen for the US-facing English route, while the European version remains a preservation-relevant variant.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern rerelease was identified.
